question: What is the Fees per semester as per the Fee Structure for Batch 2023-24?
ground_truth: As per the Fee Structure for Batch 2023-24, the 'Fees' per semester is Rs. 1,52,500 for all semesters I to VIII. Additional one-time charges at admission are Admission Fee Rs. 10,000 and Caution Deposit Rs. 20,000. Total payable in I Semester is Rs. 2,34,500 including hostel and mess advances.

question: What is the hostel fee per semester?
ground_truth: Hostel User fee charges per semester are: I Sem Rs. 22,000, II Sem Rs. 22,000, III Sem Rs. 25,000, IV Sem Rs. 25,000, V Sem Rs. 28,000, VI Sem Rs. 28,000, VII Sem Rs. 30,000, VIII Sem Rs. 30,000. An additional one-time Hostel Deposit of Rs. 10,000 is charged in I Semester. Mess Bill Advance is Rs. 20,000 per semester.

question: What time does the institute bus leave from the main gate on weekdays?
ground_truth: On weekdays the Campus (main gate) to Transit Hostel buses depart at 7:30 AM (Bus 1, 2 and 3), 8:25 AM (Bus 1, 2 and 3), 10:00 AM, 11:00 AM etc. The full weekday schedule lists 7:30 AM as the first Campus to Transit Hostel departure.

question: What is the mess menu on Monday?
ground_truth: For Mess 1 on Monday: Breakfast is Pongal, Poha Sev with Chutney, Black Chana Sprouts, Egg Bhurji, Fruits/Cornflakes, BBJ, Tea/Coffee/Bornvita. Lunch is Onion Rice, Dal Tadka, Jeera Aloo, Chawli Masala, Jaljeera with Pickle/Papad/Salad. Dinner and other days follow the weekly chart (e.g., Friday lunch is Veg & Egg Biriyani).

question: When is the Techno-Cultural Fest scheduled as per the Academic Calendar for August-November 2026?
ground_truth: As per the Academic Calendar August-November 2026, the Techno-Cultural Fest is scheduled on 30-Oct and 31-Oct 2026.
